title: EnergyPlus whole-building energy simulation program and Golden-NREL TMY3 comparison weather
publisher: United States Department of Energy and National Renewable Energy Laboratory

doi.absence_reason: The EnergyPlus 25.1.0 software release page does not assign a release-specific DOI.

measurement_uncertainty.description: EnergyPlus is a deterministic comparative simulation reference, not a measurement dataset.

known_gaps: The registered launcher requires the remainder of a compatible EnergyPlus 25.1.0 installation; it is not a standalone redistributed installation.
The comparison fixture uses adiabatic zones and deterministic constant sensible gains and losses; it does not represent a real building.
EnergyPlus IdealLoadsAirSystem modulates delivered load to the setpoint, while NexusEP currently applies a declared full capacity outside its activation deadband.
Equipment curves, fans, ducts, latent control, cycling, and part-load performance are excluded from the registered comparison.

preprocessing.description: Verify the pinned executable signature, EnergyPlus 25.1 IDD, BSD license, and Golden-NREL weather identity without executing the program.

permitted_use.purpose: Open-source comparative validation of the narrowly matched NexusEP ideal sensible-load contract
permitted_use.notes: The raw local installation files remain ignored. Reproduce from the official EnergyPlus 25.1.0 release and retain license attribution.
